name: A Bundle of Hides
summary: Jahan Hawkwing sends cured hides from the Crossroads to Thunder Bluff for leatherworking. The delivery takes you across central Kalimdor and introduces the Crossroads wind rider roost.

sections.title: Trade Across the Savanna
sections.body: Hunters bring game hides and meat to the Crossroads, where Jahan Hawkwing gathers pelts from across the Barrens. The outposts cannot process every raw hide, so he asks travelers to carry them west to Thunder Bluff. Master leatherworkers there can turn the pelts into gear for the Horde.

sections.title: Taking to the Skies
sections.body: The trail across the Barrens and into Mulgore is rough, and quilboar and predators threaten anyone carrying cargo on foot. Jahan sends you to Devrak, the Crossroads wind rider master. He can take the goods by air aboard a trained wyvern, linking the Horde’s scattered settlements.

faq.q: Who gives the quest A Bundle of Hides?
aliases: who starts a bundle of hides
where to get bundle of hides
faq.answer: Jahan Hawkwing, a tauren at the Crossroads in the Barrens, gives you the hides to carry. He has gathered pelts from local beasts and needs a reliable courier to take them toward Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Who should I bring the bundle of hides to?
faq.answer: Bring the bundle to Devrak, the orc wind rider master at the Crossroads perch. He handles air travel between the Crossroads and other major Horde hubs.

faq.q: What happens after giving the hides to Devrak?
aliases: what after a bundle of hides
faq.answer: After you give Devrak the hides, he asks you to take a wind rider and fly the cargo to Ahanu, the leatherworker atop Thunder Bluff’s high bluffs.

faq.q: Why are these hides being sent to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Jahan Hawkwing works with Ahanu in Thunder Bluff, who turns pelts from Barrens game into leather armor and goods for the tauren and their Horde allies.

faq.q: Why use a wind rider instead of walking?
faq.answer: Walking across the Barrens and climbing Thunder Bluff’s great mesa takes time and risks danger from wildlife and quilboar packs. A wind rider carries you swiftly above them.

faq.q: Does this require prior flight master experience?
faq.answer: You can learn to use the flight master system on this early delivery. Devrak’s roost shows you how wind riders connect distant regions.

angles.text: As a tauren traveler, you carry hides between hunters in the ancestral Barrens and craftsmen on Thunder Bluff’s great mesas.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on links between Kalimdor’s bases. Orcish beast masters like Devrak help bridge the distance between allied territories.
